summary: Comprehensive testing of bulk email features: CSV upload, flyer attachments, 'Over Ons' section, and dealer notification logic. All 21 backend API tests passed. Frontend UI verified working with all required elements present.

Backend: GET /api/admin/available-flyers returns list of PDF flyers with filename, size_kb, url
Backend: GET /api/admin/marketing-lists requires admin auth (returns 403 without token)
Backend: GET /api/admin/marketing-lists returns both pre-made and uploaded CSV lists
Backend: POST /api/admin/upload-marketing-csv requires admin auth
Backend: POST /api/admin/upload-marketing-csv rejects non-CSV files
Backend: POST /api/admin/upload-marketing-csv accepts comma-delimited CSV
Backend: POST /api/admin/upload-marketing-csv accepts semicolon-delimited CSV (European format)
Backend: POST /api/admin/upload-marketing-csv handles CSV without valid emails
Backend: Uploaded CSV appears in marketing-lists with is_uploaded=true flag
Backend: POST /api/admin/bulk-email requires admin auth
Backend: POST /api/admin/bulk-email sends basic email successfully
Backend: POST /api/admin/bulk-email with include_about_us=true adds 'Over Ons' section
Backend: POST /api/admin/bulk-email with flyer_filename attaches PDF
Backend: POST /api/admin/bulk-email with both options (flyer + about us) works
Backend: POST /api/admin/bulk-email handles multiple recipients
Backend: Dutch dealer (testdealer@motoimport.nl) exists and is_foreign_dealer=false
Backend: Swiss dealer (testdealer@swiss.ch) exists and is_foreign_dealer=true
Backend: GET /api/dealers returns dealers with is_foreign_dealer field
Backend: GET /api/admin/marketing-list/{filename} returns email list content
Backend: GET /api/admin/marketing-list/{nonexistent} returns 404
Frontend: CSV upload area present with 'Upload CSV bestand' label
Frontend: Marketing lists displayed (Benelux_Frankrijk, Noord_Italie, Zwitserland)
Frontend: 'Over Ons' checkbox present with description
Frontend: Flyer dropdown present with 'Geen bijlage' default option
Frontend: Subject and message input fields present
Frontend: Send button present with recipient count
critical_code_review_comments: Dealer notification logic correctly filters for Dutch dealers only (is_foreign_dealer != True) in create_motorcycle endpoint
Email notification function has additional check to skip foreign dealers
CSV upload supports both comma and semicolon delimiters (European format)
Bulk email endpoint properly handles optional flyer attachment and 'Over Ons' section
ABOUT_US_HTML constant contains proper company information for marketing emails
seed_data_creation: Created test CSV files during testing (Upload_*.csv)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bulk email features fully tested and working. Available flyers: Moto_Import_Dealer_Flyer_*.pdf (NL, DE, FR, IT). Marketing lists: Motorzaken_Benelux_Frankrijk.csv (40), Motorzaken_Noord_Italie.csv (110), Motorzaken_Zwitserland.csv (39). Dutch dealer notifications work correctly - foreign dealers are excluded.

elements: CSV upload area with drag-drop styling
